zh.title: IATA安全會議10月伊斯坦堡登場 聚焦人員價值
zh.summary: IATA安全會議10月6至8日伊斯坦堡登場；主題聚焦人與科技
body: 國際航空運輸協會（IATA）世界安全與營運會議（World Safety and Operations Conference, WSOC）將於2026年10月6日至8日在土耳其伊斯坦堡舉行，主題為「Performance Through People: Driving Safety, Operational Agility, and Crisis Response」。
會議將以人員為核心討論，議題包括人員與技術的互動、組織韌性，以及航空業如何為未來勞動力做準備。
主辦單位表示，與會者包括航空公司、監管機構、製造商、機場、飛航服務提供者與安全專家，並設有安全、客艙營運、營運及危機管理等專門議題。

en.title: IATA World Safety and Operations Conference in Istanbul to Focus on Human Edge
en.summary: IATA WSOC takes place in Istanbul from 6 to 8 October; theme puts people at the center of aviation safety discussions.
body: The International Air Transport Association (IATA) World Safety and Operations Conference (WSOC) will be held in Istanbul, Türkiye, from 6 to 8 October, 2026, under the theme 'Performance Through People: Driving Safety, Operational Agility, and Crisis Response.'

The conference will place people at the center of the discussion, with sessions covering how people interact with technology, how organizations can strengthen resilience, and how aviation can prepare its workforce for the future.

According to the organizers, the event will bring together airlines, regulators, manufacturers, airports, air navigation service providers, and safety experts, with tracks covering safety, cabin operations, operations, and crisis management.
